question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Final query for the top 3 combined points
WITH driver_final_points AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, r.year, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE ds.race_id = (
        SELECT MAX(ds2.race_id)
        FROM driver_standings ds2
        JOIN races r2 ON ds2.race_id = r2.race_id
        WHERE r2.year = r.year
    )
),
constructor_final_points AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, r.year, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE cs.race_id = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.race_id)
        FROM constructor_standings cs2
        JOIN races r2 ON cs2.race_id = r2.race_id
        WHERE r2.year = r.year
    )
),
driver_constructor AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, constructor_id
    FROM drives
),
driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT dc.year, dc.constructor_id, dc.driver_id, dcp.driver_points, cfp.constructor_points
    FROM driver_constructor dc
    JOIN driver_final_points dcp ON dc.driver_id = dcp.driver_id AND dc.year = dcp.year
    JOIN constructor_final_points cfp ON dc.constructor_id = cfp.constructor_id AND dc.year = cfp.year
    WHERE dcp.driver_points IS NOT NULL AND cfp.constructor_points IS NOT NULL
),
best_driver_per_con AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, driver_points, constructor_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_constructor_points
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, bdc.year, bdc.driver_points + bdc.constructor_points as combined_points
FROM best_driver_per_con bdc
JOIN constructors c ON bdc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE bdc.rn = 1
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
